handoff: Approve: main-checkout reads refuse old/mixed wording (shared files included) with norn upgrade named across doctor, story create/edit, tick and inbox; copies still load. AC1–AC7 traced to tests, AC8 to QA (agent); 1 minor finding (differing refusal codes).

findings.title: story create refuses an old-wording file as unknown_workflow, story edit as invalid_workflow
findings.detail:
The same cause gets two different refusal codes: story create keeps `unknown_workflow` (its code for any unusable workflow) while story edit uses `invalid_workflow`. Both name `norn upgrade` in do_instead, which is what AC1 asks; a script that branches on the code would have to handle both. The handoff notes the choice was deliberate.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional: align on one code for an old-wording refusal in a later change.
